name: Philosophy Minor

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements
sections.note: There are no specific lower division requirements, but all upper division PHIL courses have prerequisites.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least 15 philosophy upper division units, not including PHIL 300, with a minimum philosophy cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and philosophy upper division grade point average (UDGPA) of 2.0 (calculated on all SFU PHIL courses).

sections.title: Philosophy Minor: Concentration in Law and Philosophy

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students may qualify for this concentration by completing the following upper division requirements along with the associated lower division prerequisites.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete at least 18 philosophy upper division units, with a minimum philosophy cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and philosophy upper division grade point average (UDGPA) of 2.0 (calculated on all SFU PHIL courses).
